content.short: Real Assets offers a simple portfolio of tokenized stocks, bonds and gold on World Chain.
content.description: Real Assets gives users a single balanced portfolio of tokenized S&P 500 stocks, US Treasuries and physical gold, with a 60/30/10 default mix they can adjust, aimed at long-term investing. Its site describes it as stocks, bonds and gold on World Chain, and it is a World App mini app.
content.meta: Real Assets offers a tokenized stocks, bonds and gold portfolio on World Chain as a World App mini app.
